group_assessment.weighting: Neonatal hydrocephalus mouse (Ccdc39 prh) with a CSF1R inhibitor given P3-P7; measures microglia, myelin, ventricle volume and survival; no seizure or EEG endpoint. NOT WWOX EVIDENCE.

entries.proposition: Ablation efficiency: at least 89 percent of microglia removed in cortex and white matter of both genotypes at P8.
entries.snippet: The PLX5622 treatment successfully ablated ≥ 89% microglia in all three areas above in both WT and prh mutants relative to untreated-WT and prh mutants, respectively
entries.anchor: Results / PLX5622 successfully ablated neonatal microglia

entries.proposition: In healthy wild-type pups the same short treatment lowered white-matter CNPase myelination to the level of untreated hydrocephalic mutants at P8.
entries.snippet: PLX5622 treatment significantly decreased myelination in WTs to the level of prh mutants (****p < 0.0001, Fig. 4A, B).
entries.anchor: Results / PLX5622-mediated microglial ablation negatively impacts postnatal myelination

entries.proposition: The OLIG2-positive oligodendrocyte-lineage density in corpus callosum of wild-type pups also fell with ablation (P = 0.011).
entries.snippet: OLIG2+ cells density in the corpus callosum was significantly reduced in PLX-WT relative to untreated WT (*p = 0.011, Fig. 4C, D)

entries.proposition: In the hydrocephalic mutant, ablation made ventricles larger (P = 0.0323 on raw volume) and did not improve grey-matter thinning, white-matter edema or survival.
entries.snippet: Remarkably, prh mutants treated from P3-P7 with PLX5622, had even further enlarged ventricular volume compared to their untreated counterparts in both raw and relative ventricular ratio to the total brain volume
entries.anchor: Results / PLX-treated prh mice have significantly larger ventricular volume

entries.proposition: Recovery in wild-type: at P18-21, after 11-13 days off drug, myelination had recovered to untreated level (P = 0.9275).
entries.snippet: After withdrawing PLX5622 for 11–13 days, myelination was recovered in juvenile WT mice to comparable levels as untreated WT mice (Fig. 9, p = 0.9275).
entries.anchor: Results / Myelination recovery 13 days after PLX5622 cessation

entries.proposition: Mutants: PLX-treated and repopulated mutants had 13.5 percent myelination versus 55 percent in untreated mutants (n = 6 and 5), a post-hoc P of 0.0167, in animals that survived to P18-21 (median survival of the line is 10 days), so the P20 comparison is conditioned on survival.
entries.snippet: PLX-prh, n = 6, 13.5 ± 13.6%, Two-way ANOVA, post hoc *p = 0.0167
entries.anchor: Results / Myelination recovery 13 days after PLX5622 cessation

entries.proposition: The untreated-mutant versus untreated-wild-type difference at P20 was not significant by the post-hoc test (P = 0.0919) and was significant only by an unadjusted two-group t-test, which the authors call a trend.
entries.snippet: The p-value of 0.0919 in post hoc test was considered a statistical trend that in two-group comparison between them with student t-test have reached significance (t-test; *p = 0.037).

entries.proposition: The authors state the prh mutants have median survival of 10 days and typically do not survive to weaning.
entries.snippet: The prh mutants shows lower body weight and have median survival of 10 days and typically do not survive to weaning ages
entries.anchor: Results / Postnatal PLX5622 treatment did not affect growth or survival

entries.proposition: Dose: PLX5622 50 mg/kg daily subcutaneously P3 to P7 (a single dose level) is stated in the Results; the Abstract says subcutaneous.
entries.snippet: the PLX5622 treatment (P3-7, 50 mg/kg) in the prh mutant did not improve myelination, if not worsened

entries.proposition: The authors recognise sample limits in the juvenile mutants and conclude ablation of pro-inflammatory microglia gives no benefit.
entries.snippet: Although our data is limited by small sample size in juvenile mutants, PLX5622-mediated microglial ablation did not bring positive outcomes in neonatal hydrocephalus.

entries.proposition: One wild-type pup in 24 died during PLX treatment, with slightly lower body weight.
entries.snippet: Postnatal PLX5622 treatment (P3-7) induced slightly lower body weight and 1 death out of 24 WT mice

entries.proposition: Authors point to the unexamined role of hypoxia/ischaemia and call for detailed microglial development studies, so the mechanism of the harm is not established.
entries.snippet: Although we did not study the direct effect of PLX5622 on hypoxia/ischemia, future studies
